spans.s: हव m. 1. An oblation, a sacrifice; 2. invocation, prayer; 3. order, command; 4. calling, call.
हाव m. 1. Calling, a call; 2. any coquettish gesture tending to excite amorous sensations; (it is thus defined- ग्रीवारेचकसंयुक्तो भ्रूनेत्रादिविकाशकृत् । भावादीषत्प्रकाशो यः स हाव
इति कथ्यते
), जगुः सरागं ननृतुः सहावम् Bt.iii.43.
हवन n. 1. The act of offering an oblation with fire; 2. an oblation so offered; 3. invocation; 4. calling.
हवन-आयुस् m. fire.
हवनीय n. 1. Any thing fit for an oblation; 2. clarified butter.
हवित्री f. A hole made in the ground for holding the sacred fire.
हविष्य n. 1. Any thing fit for an oblation, M.iii.256, Yaj.ii.240; 2. clarified butter.
हविष्य-अशिन्, -भुज् m. fire.
हविष्य-अशिन्, -भुज् m. fire.
हविष्य-अन्न n. food fit to be eaten during certain holy days.
हविस् n. 1. Clarified butter; 2. an oblation or burnt offering, M.iii.87; 3. any thing offered as an oblation, M.iii.132.142.
हविरशन (I) n. the act of devouring clarified butter.
हविरशन (II) m. fire.
हविर्गंधा f. the śamī tree.
हविर्गेह n. a house in which an oblation is offered.
हविर्भुज् m. fire, अन्वासितमरुंधत्या स्वाहयेव हविर्भुजम् R.i.56, x.79, xiii.41, Sis.i.2, K.S.v.20.
हविर्यज्ञ m. a particular sacrifice.
हविर्याजिन् m. a priest.
हविष्मत् a. possessed of oblations.
हव्य (I) a. (f. व्या) Fit to be offered in oblations.
हव्य (II) n. 1. An oblation or offering to the gods, (op. to कव्य q.v.); 2. clarified butter; 3. an oblation in general.
हव्य (I) a. (f. व्या) Fit to be offered in oblations.
हव्य-आश m. fire.
हव्य-कव्य n. oblations to the gods and to the spirits of deceased ancestors, M.i.94, iii.97.
हव्य-वाह्, -वाह, -वाहन m. fire, (the bearer of oblations).
हव्य-वाह्, -वाह, -वाहन m. fire, (the bearer of oblations).
हव्य-वाह्, -वाह, -वाहन m. fire, (the bearer of oblations).
